title: Ride the Cascade Canyon winter train
description: Leave Durango aboard a historic narrow-gauge train and follow the Animas River into the San Juan Mountains. In winter, the route toward Cascade Canyon passes snowy forest and steep canyon walls while the railcar keeps you sheltered. The engine, old track, and remote scenery make this feel like a journey, even when you return to the same depot.
teaser: Follow the Animas River into a snowy canyon by rail.
goodToKnow: Before you go, confirm winter timetable, railcar access and excursion duration.
whyItMightDelightYou: You get the drama of a mountain expedition while still having a seat and a window.
